pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with complex, jagged perimeters. Edges exhibit sharp pixel-level transitions and high angularity. Patch area is heterogeneous, being larger on the flank than on the visible portions of the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological web. Junction nodes predominantly show tri-radiate intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, with some narrowing observed toward the lower margins.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, upright mane with a high-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth silhouette clearly defined against the out-of-focus background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A structural discontinuity is visible in the mane line at the transition point between the upper neck and the shoulder ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: A small avian silhouette (oxpecker) is perched on the rump at the posterior end of the visible dorsal ridge.
